scoring_justification: Recompute binodal/spinodal/critical points from agent's reported grid points using the same dimensionless thermodynamic equations and compare within tolerances.

outputs.description: Binodal phase boundary coordinates for slices at constant effective pressure Π=0.1 and constant temperature t=0.8.
Spinodal compositions for the isobaric and isothermal slices.
Consolute critical point coordinates for each parameter set.

output_contract.notes: All values are dimensionless. The checker recomputes the same thermodynamic model and compares coordinates within absolute tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute binodal boundary points and verify c_alpha, c_beta, P_alpha, P_beta, z against recomputed values within tolerance 0.01.
Recompute spinodal roots for each reported (t, P_o) and check that c_spinodal matches a root within tolerance 0.01.
Verify that reported (t_c, c_c, P_o_c) satisfy the spinodal and critical-point equations (Eqs. 22 and 23) within tolerance.
